checks.text: Length: typing 1 in Meters shows 3.28084 in Feet (five significant decimals at most).
Typing in the second field updates the first (two-way).
Temperature: 100 Celsius shows 212 Fahrenheit; -40 Celsius shows -40 Fahrenheit.
Switching category resets units to that category's defaults and clears the fields.
The swap button exchanges the two units and keeps the value.
Non-numeric input shows an inline message and does not show `NaN` anywhere.
Each completed conversion is added to a Recent list (newest first, at most 10); clicking one restores it.
